Q5738.reason: The UCC applies to mixed contracts only if the goods are the predominant purpose, so Connie must show the laptop was the main reason for the contract.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the moment of entry, and the defendant entered only to enjoy the party, forming the intent to steal later.

Q8324.reason: Chronic drug use leads to downregulation of dopamine receptors, causing agitation and drug-seeking behavior.
